itens.trecho: The primary conclusion I drew from this series is that the only way to properly do a live-action remake of Nickelodeon's Avatar: The Last Airbender, which is not just my favorite television series but my favorite piece of media period of all time, is to literally do a word-for-word shot-for-shot update with minimal to no changes.

Who are the writer?? Those who grew up with the memories of the original animation series, here is a bad news for you. This live action is an absolute abomination! It had a promising start, and the first 3 episodes were enjoyable. Eventually, the new writers’ plague took over and turned everything into a mess.

Truly an attempt. but beating the look of the worst movie of all time isn't a big achievement. The appearance and action of this show is nearly perfect, but the writing and plot leave so much to be desired that I can't help but wonder why anyone would watch this instead of the perfection of the original cartoon.
